notes: Known (Adamczewski 2026): Lucas gives a(p+m) = c(p+m) = 0 mod p for 0<=m<=p-2, so both Hankel matrices are anti-triangular mod p and det = (-1)^((p-1)/2) v with v = a(p-1) = 1, c(p-1) = (-1)^((p-1)/2). Outside Lean (here): all; a Lean proof exists in the OEIS Open benchmark.
